result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a loading spinner is stuck over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar banner image, indicating the image failed to load or is indefinitely loading.

issues.description: A loading spinner is overlaid in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar banner image and appears to be stuck, obscuring the image and suggesting the image is not loading or the loader never dismisses.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the banner image loads properly or replace the persistent spinner with a placeholder image; add a loading timeout with a fallback image.
